philosophyParagraphs: I am a self-taught brand identity designer based in Chennai, focused on helping D2C businesses build sharp and memorable visual identities. My work is built around consumer perception — how people see, trust, remember, and choose a brand.

I got into design the hard way, with no formal classroom and no shortcuts. Just curiosity, countless hours, and a genuine obsession with what makes a brand feel right. In the past two years, I've worked with real clients across industries, helping them go from forgettable to unforgettable through logos, visual identities, and complete brand systems.
I am especially interested in FMCG, sports, fashion, lifestyle, food, wellness, and consumer product brands that sell directly to people.

My approach is simple: I don't have a one-size-fits-all style, because your brand shouldn't look like everyone else's. Every project starts with understanding your business, your audience, and what you're really trying to say, so we can build a visual identity that says it better than words ever could.

services.name: VISUAL IDENTITY
services.desc: Logo systems, typography, color, and art direction.
